createTable.remarks: Glossary of generic food terms per language, used to enrich product names before AI classification

column.name: lang
column.remarks: ISO 639-1 language code of the term, e.g. 'el', 'lt'

column.name: term
column.remarks: The generic food term in its native language, brand-stripped, e.g. 'Ανθότυρος'

column.name: canonical_en
column.remarks: The canonical English name of the food, e.g. 'anthotyros'

column.name: description
column.remarks: English description with an explicit category anchor, injected to enrich classification

column.name: category_hint_l1
column.remarks: L1 (top-level) node of the SAFAD taxonomy path locating the term, e.g. 'Milk and dairy products'; null if unknown

column.name: category_hint_l2
column.remarks: L2 node of the SAFAD taxonomy path, e.g. 'Cheese'; null if not located that deep; set only when L1 is set

column.name: category_hint_l3
column.remarks: L3 node of the SAFAD taxonomy path; null if not located that deep; set only when L2 is set

changeSet.author: nikospara
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE TH_FOOD_TERM ADD CONSTRAINT CK_TH_FOOD_TERM__HINT_CONTIGUOUS CHECK ((NULLIF(category_hint_l1, '') IS NOT NULL OR NULLIF(category_hint_l2, '') IS NULL) AND (NULLIF(category_hint_l2, '') IS NOT NULL OR NULLIF(category_hint_l3, '') IS NULL))

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE TH_FOOD_TERM DROP CONSTRAINT CK_TH_FOOD_TERM__HINT_CONTIGUOUS
